beats.title: INT. AQUAMARINE BUBBLE - TREASURE HALL - NIGHT
INT. AQUAMARINE BUBBLE - CONTROL ROOM - NIGHT
INT. AQUAMARINE BUBBLE - TREASURE HALL - LATER

elements.text: Based on the original story by Talia Migliaccio
A sunlit island rises from a sparkling blue sea. White stone paths curve between fish-shaped weather vanes, flowering rooftops, and tiny windmills that turn with soft PURRS.

Cats of every color begin their day. A baker slides moon-shaped rolls from an oven. A kitten mail carrier pedals a bicycle with wings. In the distance, a grand building gleams: THE CAT ISLAND MEWSEUM.
A breeze passes through tall grass. For one quiet moment, the whole island seems to breathe.
Four young heroes train on a grassy hill above town.
STARGAZER, a graceful serval with star-bright spots, shakes her coat. Tiny silver moons and sharp little stars spin into the air and stick neatly into a wooden target.
Three stars. One moon. No splinters.
INVISIBILITY, a sleek Siamese, disappears. Only his nervous tail tip remains visible.
BEAM, a black cat with bright gold eyes, squints carefully. A thin beam of light slices an apple in half. The halves land in a picnic basket.
Precision. Power is easy. Precision is heroic.
LIGHTENING, a calico blur, rockets around the hill so fast the grass bends behind him. He stops with a proud grin and a dandelion stuck to his nose.
From inside their little blue mission phone comes a loud, urgent sound: PROR PRR! PROR PRR!
He taps the receiver. A tiny hologram appears: PURREDIDENT MEW, dignified and deeply worried.
Defenders, we have a terrible problem. The Savannah Rubies were stolen from the Mewseum last night.
The real Savannah Rubies? The ones guarded by the sneeze-proof glass?
The very same. Can you get them back?
The four friends exchange a look. The breeze lifts Stargazer's fur. Her spots glimmer.
Lightening zips off, realizes no one followed, and zips back.
The Mewseum is hushed and bright. Fossil fish hang from the ceiling. Ancient bowls sit in velvet cases. A banner reads: TREASURES OF THE SAVANNAH.
At the center: an empty pedestal. Broken moon-pale glass sparkles on the floor.
The thief came after midnight. No guard heard a thing.
Stargazer lowers her nose to the floor. Invisibility fades almost completely, moving around the empty case. Beam studies the glass. Lightening runs a quick circle and returns holding a snack wrapper.
No paw prints inside the case.
The glass was opened, not smashed. Whoever did this wanted everyone to think it was a smash-and-grab.
He reappears, holding a single long black hair.
The mission phone rings again: PROR PRR!
Another report. Someone wearing red gems was spotted near the beach.
Then the thief wants to be seen.
Or wants us to chase the wrong thing.
The beach is wide and golden. Pale crabs draw tidy spirals in the sand. Far out, bright fish jump like little sparks.
The Defenders search between tide pools. Lightening skids to a stop beside several clumps of long, silky black fur tangled in sea grass.
Tiny paws. Big speeches. Terrible hiding places with excellent decorating.
A CROW on a driftwood post coughs politely. In its beak: a scrap of paper with a mountain drawn on it.
That cave is dark, echoey, and extremely full of reasons not to go in.
Invisibility looks at his friends, steadied by them.
Snow falls softly through blue pines. The world is quiet except for the crunch of paws and the far-off chime of ice in the branches.
Tiny footprints climb the mountainside. At the top waits a dark cave shaped like an open mouth.
The Defenders step inside. Their breath clouds in the cold air. Strange symbols shimmer on a stone wall.
BUDDHA THE EVIL POMERANIAN stands before the wall, wearing a glittering red necklace. He is very small and very convinced of his own importance.
Portal, portal, shiny and grand, take me far from Cat Island!
Buddha! Step away from the magical wall.
Buddha spins around, delighted to be caught dramatically.
Defenders! You found clue number one. How rude.
The stone wall opens like water. A glowing portal hums. Wind fills the cave.
Stargazer leaps forward. Buddha grabs the rubies. The portal pulls them both in.
Beam, Invisibility, and Lightening dive into the light.
VSSSHHHH! The three Defenders tumble out of the portal and land in soft white sand.
This beach is not Cat Island. Giant flowers sway near the shore. In the sky, slow clouds drift in the shapes of sleeping cats.
Good news. Sand is softer than mountains.
A calm gray cat in a blue vest approaches, carrying a notebook and a shell-shaped badge.
You are on the South Whisker Coast. I am Ocean, Secret Cat Investigators.
I'm Beam. This is Lightening and Invisibility. We're the Defenders of Cat Island.
And we are missing one Defender, one evil Pomeranian, and one very important set of rubies.
Everyone in the SCI knows Buddha. He leaves fur, receipts, and speeches everywhere.
Ocean leads them to a hidden door in a cliff. It opens into a bright, cozy headquarters full of maps, periscopes, string boards, and tea cups.
LUNA, FLAME, and MOONBEAM gather around a map dotted with silly, impossible hideouts.
SCI, these are the Defenders. Their friend was pulled through Buddha's portal.
Then we start with his nearest hideout.
Deep tropical forest. Wobbly walls. Terrible acoustics.
The team rides in Ocean's BUG MOBILE, a round little vehicle with beetle wings folded against its sides. It bumps through green shadow and gold shafts of sunlight.
Vines curl around enormous flowers. Dew drops hang like glass bells. Nobody speaks for a moment, listening to the forest creak and chirp.
Then we bring her back so she can complain about the mosquitoes herself.
The Jell-O Dome sits in a clearing, shimmering red and green. It jiggles in the breeze.
They hide behind two enormous leaves. From inside comes Buddha's voice.
Portal, portal, don't be late, take me to hideout number eight!
They rush in. The floor wiggles under them. Invisibility nearly disappears from embarrassment when he slips.
At the center of the dome, STARGAZER is tied with licorice-colored rope, annoyed but unharmed.
We came as fast as possible!
You are Lightening. That sentence has limits.
Beam carefully slices the rope with a tiny laser line.
Did Buddha say where he was going?
No. But he was proud of something red and fake.
Moonbeam lifts a sparkling red crystal from a nearby cushion.
Then we check the Chocolate Cube next.
The Bug Mobile's wings unfold. It lifts into the pink sky and glides toward Cube City, where every building is a cube: glass cubes, cheese cubes, ice cubes, and many suspicious chocolate cubes.
The team enters a chocolate cube in the middle of a lake of cream. The walls smell delicious. Lightening licks one.
Do not eat the crime scene.
They find two more red crystals in a velvet box. Beside them sits a receipt.
Buddha bought four red crystals yesterday.
He wanted us to waste time chasing fake rubies.
If two are here and one was in the Jell-O Dome, the last decoy will be at Rock Candy Palace.
Crystal City glows beneath the moon. Towers of sugar crystal throw rainbows across the streets. Everyone puts on sunglasses.
After many shining stairs, the team finds Buddha's room and the last red crystal sitting on a pillow.
All the decoys are accounted for.
Which means the real rubies are wherever Buddha feels safest.
The Aquamarine Bubble. Under the ocean.
Wonderful. A building that wobbles was not enough. Now we visit a building that drowns.
A lantern glows over a seaside shop. JACK, a cheerful cat with whiskers like seaweed, waits beside two enormous bags.
Ocean! Scuba gear for a secret mission?
The team suits up. Invisibility's mask fogs immediately.
Stay together. If you're scared, say so.
Good. Now we know where to stand.
She stands beside him. He smiles, small but real.
They dive. The sea is dark blue and full of soft living light. Tiny fish lanterns drift past. A turtle the size of a table glides overhead.
In the distance, hidden by coral, shines the AQUAMARINE BUBBLE.
They swim close. No one is visible inside.
Stargazer extends one claw and cuts a neat opening in the outer bubble. One by one, they slip inside. Beam plugs the opening. Water drains with a gentle glug-glug-glug.
A steel door blocks the way.
His laser draws a careful glowing circle. The door piece pops free.
INT. AQUAMARINE BUBBLE - TREASURE HALL - NIGHT
The inside is breathtaking: fish tanks, carved chairs, stolen paintings, tiny fountains, golden teapots, and a portrait labeled MEWNA LISA.
Buddha stole half a museum and arranged it by color.
A camera shaped like a puppy head swivels toward them. A little label reads PUPCAM 2000.
Buddha's voice booms from hidden speakers.
Welcome to my impossible-to-find Aquamarine Bubble. Please admire the furniture before you fail.
The heroes race through curved halls. Doors open into rooms of stolen clocks, glowing shells, and one closet full of dramatic capes.
Why does he have so many capes?
INT. AQUAMARINE BUBBLE - CONTROL ROOM - NIGHT
Buddha stands at a control panel beneath a swirling half-made portal. The real Savannah Rubies glow around his neck.
Stargazer flicks three sharp starbursts. They pin Buddha's cape to the wall without touching him.
My cape! That was my fleeing cape!
Invisibility vanishes. The portal lever moves mysteriously away from Buddha's paw.
Lightening runs circles around the room, creating a harmless breeze that spins Buddha in place.
Beam aims at the portal machine. He breathes once. A precise laser snips a single wire. The portal flickers out like a candle.
Ocean and Flame cuff Buddha gently but firmly.
Buddha, you are under arrest for stealing the Savannah Rubies and many, many other things.
Where are the rest of the treasures?
Buddha sighs with the deep tragedy of someone who has been caught by teamwork.
Behind the Mewna Lisa. Combination fourteen, thirty-two, eight. But open it respectfully. It is a very nice safe.
INT. AQUAMARINE BUBBLE - TREASURE HALL - LATER
The team opens the safe. Inside are the Savannah Rubies, jewels, coins, and a tiny plaque that reads PROPERTY OF SOMEONE ELSE.
Purresident Mew appears on the mission phone, signal crackling underwater.
We found the rubies, Purresident Mew.
Morning arrives soft and pink. Police cats load waterproof sacks of recovered treasures. Buddha, in a tiny scuba suit, sulks beside Officer Pawly.
I request a cell with tasteful curtains.
Beam and Invisibility hand over the last sack. Flame checks a list.
Actually, the police have no place to store it. They suggested it become a shared headquarters.
With doors that do not wobble?
With friends who know the way home.
The Defenders and SCI look out at the sea. Beneath the water, the Aquamarine Bubble glows like a small blue moon.
Their mission phone rings: PROR PRR! Everyone turns.
Defenders, I am sorry to interrupt, but a very large cheese wheel has rolled into City Hall.
They run toward the new day as the sea shines behind them.
